instruction: A colleague flagged one of our key accounts as a compliance risk in an internal email. What is the value of that account's currently open deal?

provenance.construction_method: Author-constructed multi-source retrieval over a coherent named-customer dataset; natural-language prompts; sweep-all / plan-time-decidable. Labelled honestly per IT-017.
provenance.difficulty_axis: number of distinct sources that must be combined
